answer: Proof-of-spacetime requires AI agents to reserve storage for cryptographic plots, validating continuous allocation against a quartz clock. An attacker incurs the verifiable capital cost of provisioning dedicated hard drives per identity. Compressing these challenges into a cryptographic pearl renders credentials as durable as jade. However, this mechanism penalizes lightweight agents with modest disk space, and well-funded adversaries can still amass identities by purchasing bulk storage.
